---
name: Problem with a clause
about: A requirement that is unsafe, unclear, unachievable, or mislabeled
title: "BES 0001 §"
labels: spec
---

**Clause and release.** Which clause identifier, at which release.

**What goes wrong.** The situation a deployment actually runs into. Concrete beats abstract.

**Which labels it carries, and whether they are right.** Every clause carries one CONTROL value, being CONSENSUS, SOFTWARE, LEGAL, or GOVERNANCE, and at least one EVIDENCE value, being CHAIN, REPRODUCIBLE, or DOCUMENTARY. See "The two label fields" in BES 0001. A clause labeled stronger than what actually backs it is the most serious kind of problem in this repository.

**Suggested change, if you have one.** A proposal is not required to open an issue.
